newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Aodong Pharmaceutical to launch A share offer.
newsitem.headline: Aodong Pharmaceutical to launch A share offer.

text.p: Yanbian Aodong Pharmaceutical (Group) Co Ltd said on Friday that it would make an initial public offering of 13.60 million class A shares in northeastern China's Jilin province on October 8.
The offer, which will end by October 16, has been priced at 7.20 yuan per share, the firm said in an offer prospectus in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Friday.

The firm said that it had been granted permission by the China Securities Regulatory Commission to list 4.40 million shares for employees, issued at one yuan per share in 1993, along with the class A stock, on the Shenzhen bourse in the near future.

The company, based in the city of Dunhua in Jilin province, said it planned to use the bulk of the proceeds from the offer to set up a 59.50-million-yuan drug venture with a German firm and a Switzerland-based company.
Aodong said it would hold a 70 percent-stake in the project, with the remaining 30 percent evenly split between the two overseas partners.
On completion, the project should post net earnings of 9.13 million yuan on annual sales of 80 million yuan, Aodong said but gave no further details.
It added that part of the proceeds from the issue would be used to renovate production facilities.
Aodong said that, according to Chinese accounting standards, it had forecast net earnings of 63.16 million yuan in 1996, compared with 25.94 million yuan last year and 20.84 million yuan in 1994.
The firm said that most of its medicinal products were sold in the domestic market and that it aimed to gradually increase exports to Southeast Asia in the coming years.
Aodong said it currently had total share capital of 58 million shares, including 24.50 million state shares, 15.90 million institutional shares and 17.60 million staff shares.
Shanghai Guotai Securities has been named main underwriter for the offer and Aodong's listing promoter, the prospectus said.
